windows.note: Presentation-only quarantine of the ordinary coverage outcome/episode products for the registered forward 2-1-2 continuation floor-outcome study and its descriptive companion. quarantine_from is the earliest session the collector may redact once this policy is deployed; it is NOT the trial's eligible start, which is fixed by a later pre-collection amendment. Sessions already collected before deployment are not rewritten. released_at is set by the operator only after the legitimate one look; until then every active session is quarantined. Raw cov-v0.1 events and the ep-v0.1 reduction are never altered.
